lines.zh: 我移动得很慢，一步一顿
lines.en: I move slowly, one heavy step at a time.
Each step drags slowly.

lines.zh: 草在我脚下被压弯，又弹回
lines.en: Grass bends under me and springs back.

lines.zh: 我从树影里一次挪一寸
lines.en: I shift an inch at a time out of the tree shadow.

lines.zh: 我的影子方正，像块石头
lines.en: My shadow is square, like a stone.
I do not go around; I walk through.
The brush is pushed aside by my bulk.
My breath booms under the armor.
I stop and listen a while.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，不快不慢
lines.en: I follow behind you, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 我转身的时候，甲要分两步
lines.en: I need two moves to turn my armor.
I cross a stand of low trees at an angle.
I stand still, plates drawn in.
I raise a hand and look at it.
Grass sways by my feet.

lines.zh: 我在等，等得很耐心，护甲十点撑得住。
lines.en: I wait patiently; ten armor points can take it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在甲缝里不动
lines.en: My eyes sit still in the gaps of armor.
A bug crawls across my plate.
I let out one slow breath.
My plates darken in the sun.

lines.zh: 我把手垂在身侧，甲分开
lines.en: I let my hands hang, plates parting.

lines.zh: 一只鸟落在我肩上又飞走
lines.en: A bird lands on my shoulder and leaves.
My plating covers me closely.
My armor covers me well.
Everywhere you might hit is hard.
My shell grinds with a low sound.
You step back; I take another half.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛从缝里看着你
lines.en: My eyes watch you from the gap.
I have no intention of hurrying.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，破不了甲
lines.en: What you hold will not break plate.
My head tilts slightly.

lines.zh: 你贴着我看，甲缝里也有眼睛
lines.en: You look close; there are eyes in the seams too.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，甲响了一下
lines.en: I step back and a plate rings.
I press the dent in my plate.
My plates crack open, showing what's inside.
I draw my plates tighter.

lines.zh: 我把甲一片片重新排好
lines.en: I realign my plates one by one.
I step back and the grass flattens.
A plate edge has curled.
I straighten and the plates ring three times.
I draw my head a little into the armor.
I breathe low once.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西我没兴趣
lines.en: I have no interest in what you hold.
What I eat is not here.
Still, you have held it up a while.
I reach out, slowly.
Just set it down; I will take it.
I will not thank you for taking it.

lines.zh: 我伸手过去，甲碰在一起
lines.en: I reach over, my plates knocking.
I sniff; I do not recognize it.
Let go and it is mine.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，手上没有温度
lines.en: I hold it; my hand has no warmth.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，退了三步
lines.en: You hit me and give three steps.
One shift of my foot and you are pushed aside.
Plate meets bone, dully.
I do not stop; I keep walking.
You are at my flank, and I sweep you off.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞在甲上，滑开了
lines.en: Your shoulder slides off my plate.
My plate edge stops your ribs.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，你被推着走了一步
lines.en: We collide and you are pushed one step.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，甲盖住了肩
lines.en: I lower myself, plates over my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我没有动，是你撞在我甲上
lines.en: I did not move; you hit my plate.
Her plates are older than mine.
We stand and our plates touch.

lines.zh: 我们一起慢慢转向同一个方向
lines.en: We turn slowly the same way together.
Her breathing is dull too.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，甲替我们说
lines.en: We do not speak; the armor speaks for us.

lines.zh: 她把甲靠过来，声音很轻
lines.en: She leans her plate in, softly.
We stand with our plates aligned.

lines.zh: 她替我推了一下歪掉的甲片
lines.en: She pushes a crooked plate back.

lines.zh: 我们一起慢慢走了一段
lines.en: We walk a stretch together, slowly.
Her shadow is squarer than mine.
I bend and my plates stack.
I clamp it between both hands.
It is small in my hand.
I look, and put it back.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我不太需要
lines.en: I do not much need what lies on the ground.
I kneel and my plates press into the soil.
I hold it between my fingers.
Ten armor plates, at your own height.
It is heavier than I thought.

lines.zh: 我把它放进甲缝里收着
lines.en: I tuck it into a seam.

lines.zh: 我停下来，甲展开了一点
lines.en: I stop and my plates open a little.
My heavy plates tilt forward.
You are directly ahead.
I close the gap inch by inch.
I do not shout; shouting wastes breath.
I flatten my plates one by one.
My steps settle into a rhythm.
You stand there and do not retreat.
I lower my head directly at you.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖到你的脚上
lines.en: My shadow reaches your feet.
I am in no hurry; you cannot break me.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，甲在空中张开
lines.en: I raise a hand, plates opening midair.

lines.zh: 你退到树边，树挡不住我
lines.en: You back to a tree; it will not stop me.
I count your steps; they are too wild.

lines.zh: 我把前脚往前移了半尺
lines.en: I move my front foot forward half a foot.

lines.zh: 我的甲缝里透出一点光
lines.en: A little light comes through my seams.
I follow you, heavy-footed.
You go round a tree; I do not.

lines.zh: 主世界到处都有我，慢慢走。
lines.en: I'm everywhere in the overworld, walking slowly.
You strike me and the plate rings.
I neither stop nor hurry.
I walk straight on, no detours.
You go round the tree; I go through.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在落叶上压出声音
lines.en: My steps press sound from the leaves.
You strike me and I do not even turn.
A few more marks are on my plate.
I neither stop nor speed up.
You retreat up the slope; it is too slippery.

lines.zh: 我一伸手，够到了你的影
lines.en: One reach and I touch your shadow.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让你的耳膜发闷
lines.en: My breathing dulls your ears.

lines.zh: 你听得出我在哪，却跑不掉
lines.en: You hear where I am, and cannot escape.

lines.zh: 我把甲缝收紧，没有破口
lines.en: I close my seams; there is no gap.

lines.zh: 你换了几次方向，我都跟着
lines.en: You change direction several times; I follow.

lines.zh: 地上的草被我整片压倒
lines.en: The grass goes down in whole patches.
My hand stays raised, tireless.
You back to the river; I do not fear water.
I bring my hand down.

lines.zh: 我的甲片互相摩擦，一步一顿。
lines.en: My plates grind as I take one step at a time.

lines.zh: 我一拳打在树干上，树断了
lines.en: I punch a trunk and it snaps.
My plate edge scrapes you.
My plate edge sweeps your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩在你旁边，地陷了
lines.en: I stamp beside you and the ground sinks.
I drive my elbow down.
One ram and you give two steps.
You cut my plate and the blade slides off.

lines.zh: 缓慢地抬手，砸向你的肩。
lines.en: I raise my arm slowly and slam your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸在你脚边，土溅起
lines.en: My fist lands by your feet and dirt sprays.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖顶在你的腹上
lines.en: My knee drives into your gut.
I turn my head and a plate grazes your face.

lines.zh: 你挡我的手臂，被压下去
lines.en: You block my arm and are pressed down.

lines.zh: 我连着两下，第二下更重
lines.en: I strike twice; the second is heavier.

lines.zh: 我撤手的时候，你的手在抖
lines.en: When I withdraw, your hands are shaking.

lines.zh: 你退到树根上，绊了一下
lines.en: You back onto a root and stumble.
I sweep you aside with a hand.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，让你打累了
lines.en: I stand still and let you tire.

lines.zh: 我的甲把你推得滑了半步
lines.en: My plate pushes you half a step.
My shadow moves first.
I shift out from behind the tree, slowly.
My plates align one by one.
I plant my feet firm.
The wind goes around me.

lines.zh: 我先站出来，甲还在合拢
lines.en: I step out first, plates still closing.
A gap in the woods has closed.
I settle, plates in neat order.

lines.zh: 我把头转向有声音的地方
lines.en: I turn my head to the sound.
I lift a foot and leaves scatter.
Grass still clings to my plates.

lines.zh: 我向前踏出一步，地面一沉
lines.en: I step forward and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 火在甲上烤，热透到里面
lines.en: Fire bakes my plate and the heat goes through.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，甲磕在石上
lines.en: I roll down the slope, plate striking stone.

lines.zh: 水从甲缝里进去，我动不了了
lines.en: Water enters the seams and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 爆风把甲片掀开了一角
lines.en: The blast lifts a corner of my plate.
Something lodges in my seams.

lines.zh: 那股力量绕过甲，直接打进去
lines.en: That force bypasses the plate and strikes within.
Empty, this armor feels even heavier.

lines.zh: 雷打在甲上，一路传到脚
lines.en: Lightning hits my plate and runs to my feet.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我一整块往下坠
lines.en: The ground goes; I fall as one solid mass.
